| # UDS customer tool {#uds-customer-tool-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                 |                                                                                                                                                         |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This section provides hints for the creation of a customer specific diagnostic tool using UDS.

 

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"} | •The UDS new instance on any CAN channel can be added from easyConfig.                                                                          |
|                                                                                |                                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                | •The Parameters and Process Data Identifiers (DIDs) with a new security level can be mapped from easyConfig.                                    |
|                                                                                |                                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                | •For security access the callbacks are provided to the application to have the customer algorithm. Standard 16 bytes seed and key is supported. |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
